avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 6 to 22 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.detail: left April 29; earlier seasons: May 19 (2023), May 13 (2024), May 6 (2025)

evidence.name: Stampede Pass

evidence.name: Corral Pass

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the third highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Corral Pass (5,810 ft) and the lowest at Sawmill Ridge (4,640 ft) and Stampede Pass (3,850 ft).
